posts.text: Excited to share I’ll be joining EY this summer as a Technology Consulting Intern! Thank you to Rick Tan for taking the time to chat with me and for his support throughout the hiring process. Looking forward to contributing to an incredible team at the intersection of AI and business strategy.

I just wrapped up an amazing experience presenting the fraud-detection NLP research I worked on as part of an incredible team at the EMNLP conference in Suzhou, China! 🇨🇳✨ Getting up on the podium to walk everyone through our work was a really fun moment. Outside of that, I spent a lot of time exploring the latest NLP papers and prototype demos. It was super cool to see what’s trending right now and how quickly the space is evolving.
